name: Aclazotz
aliases: the bat god of the night
description: Aclazotz is the bat god of night on Ixalan, creator of the first vampires and eternal enemy of the Threefold Sun.

description_citations.text: Ixalan: card flavor text (Ixalan, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary.text: Aclazotz is the bat god of night on Ixalan, creator of the first vampires and eternal enemy of the Threefold Sun.

bio.text: A mortal of the Fourth People, afraid of death, slaughtered his people, drank their blood and killed the final god as it emerged, becoming the bat god.

"Ixalan (plane)", section "Fifth Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: He hardened the veil between life and death and whispered promises of eternal life to the frightened, and his cults sparked the Whispering War.

bio.text: Ojer Axonil defeated him, tore out one of his eyes and imprisoned him beyond the Core, where he fell into a slumber.

"Legion of Dusk", section "The crisis of faith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Free, he broke his golden chains, bit Vito and turned his followers into bat-winged demons, and flew to snuff out Chimil by reforming a sphere around the sun.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz kills the Ancient One and usurps his place among the Deep Gods.
timeline.quote: He was killed by Aclazotz, who usurped his place in the pantheon.

citation.text: "List of deities", section "The Deep Gods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arguel's vision leads him into the jungles of Ixalan to the lost temple of Aclazotz.
timeline.quote: Arguel's vision led him into the jungles of Ixalan . . .

citation.text: Arguel's Blood Fast (Ixalan Promos, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz slays the last Deep God before he can emerge, eating him and taking his place.
timeline.quote: Before the last God could emerge, Aclazotz slew him, eating him and taking his place.

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Fifth Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz slips through the door Tan Jolom left open and hardens the veil between life and death, so the dead no longer become Echoes.
timeline.quote: he hardened the gossamer veil between life and death

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Whispering War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz's cults spread, and the Whispering War erupts when leaders try to stop them.
timeline.quote: Aclazotz's cults fought back, and the fields and cities of the Komon raged with violence.

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Whispering War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ojer Axonil leads a thousand champions, defeats Aclazotz, tears out one of his eyes and imprisons him, ending the Whispering War.
timeline.quote: tore out one of Aclazotz's eyes and imprisoned him

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Whispering War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Huatli and Angrath find a bat-marked tomb near Orazca and Huatli recalls the legend of the Bat of the East.
timeline.quote: There's a legend that says the bat of the East met Aclazotz

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Elenda finds the Immortal Sun at Orazca and sleeps in a tomb of Aclazotz until the city awakens.
timeline.quote: she put herself in an enchanted sleep in a tomb of the bat-god Aclazotz

citation.text: "Elenda of Garrano", section "Return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexian invasion exposes entrances to the Core and awakens Aclazotz.
timeline.quote: the bat god Aclazotz was awoken from his slumber

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vito Quijano de Pasamonte frees Aclazotz in Ixalan's Core and he and his followers become batlike demons.
timeline.quote: the bat god bestowed his blessing on Vito and his followers, turning them into batlike demons .

citation.text: "Legion of Dusk", section "The crisis of faith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz escapes on a Dusk Legion ship bound for Torrezon to find Vona.
timeline.quote: Aclazotz escaped, securing passage to Torrezon on a Dusk Legion ship.

citation.text: "Legion of Dusk", section "The crisis of faith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vito announces the door leads to the resting place of Aclazotz and promises to return him to Torrezon.
timeline.quote: is a door that leads to the resting place of our ancient god and sire, Aclazotz, creator of the first vampires.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito resolves that he alone is Aclazotz's instrument and will bring the god to Alta Torrezon.
timeline.quote: He would prove himself worthy by bringing Aclazotz to Alta Torrezon, ending the tiresome theological debates that plagued his people.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Anim and Akal react with fear, saying Aclazotz has been imprisoned for ages and some Oltec may still worship him.
timeline.quote: If the vampires find these allies, they may at last be powerful enough to release the bat god from his prison.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito learns that Aclazotz is a prisoner and feels doubt, then pride.
timeline.quote: Vito faltered at the mention of imprisonment.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito sees Aclazotz chained with golden chains inlaid with cosmium crystals.
timeline.quote: The bat god crouched on the floor, shrouded by his wings and wrapped in loops of thick golden chains inlaid with hundreds of pink crystals.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz announces the end of the Fifth Age and demands sacrifices.
timeline.quote: The end of the Fifth Age is upon us

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The prisoners are fed to Aclazotz, and his eye brightens with each death.
timeline.quote: One by one, the prisoners were delivered unto the bat god, who feasted on their essences as Vito respectfully averted his gaze.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz breaks his golden chains.
timeline.quote: A concussive burst of magic struck everyone in the room as the gold links snapped in a dozen places.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz bites Vito and blesses the others, transforming them into bat creatures.
timeline.quote: In a flash, he sank them deep into Vito's neck and torso.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz leads the legion out and vows to imprison Chimil and end the Fifth Age.
timeline.quote: I will end the Fifth Age at last, and my children will bring the Sixth Age to the plane.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz reforms the shattered sphere around the sun to imprison Chimil.
timeline.quote: Aclazotz wielded his power to reform a shattered sphere that would soon imprison Chimil.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The prison's shadow darkens the Core.
timeline.quote: The shadow of that prison fell across the land, enshrouding it in a darkness deeper than any night in Torrezon.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz demands more sacrifices and Vito shrieks the order to the Legion.
timeline.quote: I require more sacrifices. You will bring them to me.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Wayta sees Aclazotz and the transformed vampires fly to the cosmium reef.
timeline.quote: led by a bat as large as three or four people standing end to end: Aclazotz.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Akal says Anim is mobilizing the Thousand Moons, but forces will be stretched thin by two threats.
timeline.quote: My sister was mobilizing the Thousand Moons to mount a defense, but between this and Aclazotz, our forces will be spread thin.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito boasts of making himself a saint and of ruling at Aclazotz's side with Vona.
timeline.quote: Together, Vona and I will rule at our master's side

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito dies asking Aclazotz why he forsook him.
timeline.quote: why have you forsaken me?

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: A captured cosmium eater says Aclazotz is free and will end the Fifth Age.
timeline.quote: He gathers his children, and soon he will end the Fifth Age and begin a new age of blood.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Amalia tells Kellan she feels she has been living a lie about her faith.
timeline.quote: I feel as if I've been living a lie.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz, in the hold of a ship bound for Torrezon, plans to conquer it and later destroy Chimil.
timeline.quote: Soon the ship would reach Torrezon, a land of sheep awaiting their promised shepherd to lead them to eternal life.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz singles out Vona de Iedo as the vampire he wants at his right wing.
timeline.quote: One vampire he craved above all others: Vona de Iedo, the Antifex.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Elenda reveals the second expedition is led by Vito, a hierophant of the Antifex, and could bring Aclazotz to Alta Torrezon.
timeline.quote: This group is led by Vito Quijano de Pasamonte, one of the Antifex's hierophants

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Elenda warns that if Aclazotz sets claw on Torrezon the realm will tear itself apart.
timeline.quote: If Aclazotz sets one claw on Torrezon, the realm will tear itself apart

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz's undead forces approach the temple of Ojer Kaslem and meet a wall of flourishing life.
timeline.quote: As Aclazotz's undead forces approached the temple of Ojer Kaslem, they met a roaring wall of vibrant, flourishing life.

citation.series: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
citation.text: Branching Evolution (The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz plunges the Core into darkness by closing dark shards around Chimil.
timeline.quote: Aclazotz laughed as the dark shards closed around Chimil, plunging the Core into unnatural darkness.

citation.text: Malicious Eclipse (The Lost Caverns of Ixalan, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A mortal of the Fourth People, afraid of death, slaughters his people, drinks their blood, and kills the final god as it emerges, becoming the bat god Aclazotz.
timeline.quote: As the final god emerged, he killed it and drank its divinity, becoming a horrific bat god with dominion over the border between life and death.

citation.text: "Aclazotz", section "Birth of a betrayer god". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz hardens the veil between life and death into stone and whispers promises of eternal life to the terrified and bereaved.
timeline.quote: give yourselves to me, and you will live forever.

citation.text: "Aclazotz", section "Whispering  War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Cults of Aclazotz fight back against the Komon Winaq leaders, and violence rages through their fields and cities.
timeline.quote: Aclazotz's cults fought back, and the fields and cities of the Komon Winaq raged with violence.

citation.text: "Aclazotz", section "Whispering  War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ojer Axonil battles Aclazotz, tears out one of his eyes, and drags him back beyond the veil while his most faithful slip away from the Core.
timeline.quote: where the god of fury and strength tore out one of Aclazotz's eyes and subdued him.

citation.text: "Aclazotz", section "Whispering  War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Imprisoned, Aclazotz falls into a slumber.
timeline.quote: While imprisoned, Aclazotz fell into a slumber.

citation.text: "Aclazotz", section "Imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The New Phyrexian Invasion awakens Aclazotz, and a Church of Dusk expedition led by Vito frees him with blood sacrifices.
timeline.quote: He then burst free of his bindings and granted his supplicants demonic power.

citation.text: "Aclazotz", section "Freedom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz flies to Chimil to snuff it out, but his minions are defeated by the Sun Empire.
timeline.quote: However, they were defeated by the forces of the Sun Empire present in the Core.

citation.text: "Aclazotz", section "Freedom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz escapes to Torrezon on a Dusk Legion ship to find Vona.
timeline.quote: Aclazotz escaped, securing passage to Torrezon on a Dusk Legion ship.

citation.text: "Aclazotz", section "Freedom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz returned and tried to reassemble Chimil's imprisoning sphere, briefly plunging the Core into night.
timeline.quote: the bat god attempted to reassemble Chimil's imprisoning sphere, briefly plunging the Core into nighttime.

citation.text: "Chimil", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz, last of the Fourth People, slaughters the others out of fear of death and becomes godlike.
timeline.quote: His fear of death drove him to become godlike

citation.text: "Core of Paradise", section "Fourth Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz slays the last Deep God before he can emerge, eating him and taking his place.
timeline.quote: Before the last God could emerge, Aclazotz slew him, eating him and taking his place.

citation.text: "Core of Paradise", section "Fifth Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz hardens the veil between life and death and feeds on fear, promising followers eternal life.
timeline.quote: he hardened the gossamer veil between life and death

citation.text: "Core of Paradise", section "Whispering War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Axonil leads a thousand champions against Aclazotz, tears out one of his eyes and imprisons him, ending the Whispering War.
timeline.quote: the god of fury and strength tore out one of Aclazotz's eyes and imprisoned him

citation.text: "Core of Paradise", section "Whispering War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Legion of Dusk frees Aclazotz, who tries to snuff out the inner sun, while the Mycotyrant attacks the Oltec; both are defeated but escape to the surface.
timeline.quote: The latter faction freed Aclazotz , who then attempted to snuff out the plane's inner sun.

citation.text: "Core of Paradise", section "Quiet Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz turns several Legion of Dusk vampires into demons to help eclipse Chimil.
timeline.quote: several Legion of Dusk vampires were turned into demons by Aclazotz

citation.text: "Demon", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Legion of Dusk frees Aclazotz, who tries to snuff out the inner sun, while the Mycotyrant attacks the Oltec; both are defeated but escape to the surface.
timeline.quote: The latter faction freed Aclazotz, who then attempted to snuff out the plane's inner sun.

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Rediscovery of the Core". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kellan and Amalia side with the Oltecs against Aclazotz and help defeat the god and his vampire minions.
timeline.quote: After helping defeat the god and his demonic vampire minions

citation.text: "Kellan", section "Lost Caverns of Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dark creatures enter the world through a door left open by Tan Jolom; Aclazotz hardens the veil between life and death and feeds on fear.
timeline.quote: he hardened that gossamer veil between life and death to impregnable stone

citation.text: "Oltec", section "The Whispering War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Cults of Aclazotz form and fight back against the elders, spreading violence across the Core.
timeline.quote: Aclazotz's cults fought back, and the fields and cities of the Komon Winaq raged with violence.

citation.text: "Oltec", section "The Whispering War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ojer Axonil and his thousand champions defeat Aclazotz, tearing out an eye and dragging him back beyond the veil, ending the Whispering War.
timeline.quote: the god of fury and strength tore out one of Aclazotz's eyes and subdued him

citation.text: "Oltec", section "The Whispering War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Cosmium eaters free Aclazotz from imprisonment and are turned into vampire demons.
timeline.quote: They were turned into vampire demons by their god after freeing him from his imprisonment.

citation.text: "Oltec", section "Religion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The company becomes infested with fanatics seeking to return Aclazotz to Alta Torrezon.
timeline.quote: the company quickly became infested by bloodthirsty eschatological fanatics

citation.text: "Queen's Bay Company", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vito feeds kidnapped Oltec to Aclazotz, who breaks his bindings and blesses Vito and his followers, turning them into batlike demons.
timeline.quote: he fed these people to the ancient god, who broke his bindings

citation.text: "Queen's Bay Company", section "To Ixalan's Core". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz attacks Chimil while Vito's followers rampage in the Oltec city and kill Inti.
timeline.quote: killed Huatli 's cousin Inti

citation.text: "Queen's Bay Company", section "To Ixalan's Core". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz escapes on a Dusk Legion ship toward Torrezon, intending to find Vona.
timeline.quote: Aclazotz escaped, securing passage to Torrezon on a Dusk Legion ship.

citation.text: "Queen's Bay Company", section "To Ixalan's Core". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The vampires break out and free Aclazotz, who turns them into demons; the armies clash, the vampires are defeated, and Aclazotz flees the Core.
timeline.quote: Aclazotz was released and turned the vampires into powerful demons under his control

citation.text: "Quintorius", section "On Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During a blood fast Vito receives visions from Aclazotz.
timeline.quote: Vito heard whispers and received visions from Aclazotz

citation.text: "Vito Quijano de Pasamonte", section "Freeing Aclazotz". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vito feeds kidnapped Oltec to Aclazotz, who breaks free and turns Vito and followers into demons.
timeline.quote: he fed these people to the ancient god, who broke his bindings.

citation.text: "Vito Quijano de Pasamonte", section "Freeing Aclazotz". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vito's followers rampage into the Oltec city and kill Inti.
timeline.quote: killed Huatli 's cousin Inti

citation.text: "Vito Quijano de Pasamonte", section "Freeing Aclazotz". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Vito's death, Aclazotz identifies Vona as a prime candidate to be his champion.
timeline.quote: Aclazotz identified Vona as a prime candidate to be his champion

citation.text: "Vona de Iedo", section "Antifex". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vito reveals the mission is to awaken Aclazotz and bring him to Torrezon.
timeline.quote: Vito declared their expedition's mission was to awaken Aclazotz

citation.text: "Amalia Benavides Aguirre", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Core a Sun Empire party led by Huatli appears and the vampires are imprisoned, but all except Amalia break out to free Aclazotz.
timeline.quote: all besides Amalia broke out to pursue Vito's goal

citation.text: "Amalia Benavides Aguirre", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the god and his vampire minions are defeated, Amalia offers to accompany Kellan and they go through an Omenpath together.
